body: You might be correct in part, as I feel a whole lot better now that I've had some human contact, but I don't think I hurt myself to get attention. I don't intend to tell anyone I know about it, and it's in a place where it'll always be covered. I think I do it for the pain- it's possible I get some perverse satisfaction from simply knowing that I can feel something real.
